stories.title: Pakistan Navy vessel collides with Indian warship in Arabian Sea

en.title: Pakistan Navy vessel collides with Indian warship in Arabian Sea
en.summary: A Pakistani naval vessel collided with an Indian warship in the Arabian Sea after approaching at high speed. India lodged a formal protest and the Pakistani ship returned to harbour with damage.

stories.title: ‘U.S. pressure mounts, Modi govt keeps surrendering’: Mallikarjun Kharge on Russia sanctions bill

en.title: 'U.S. pressure mounts, Modi govt keeps surrendering': Mallikarjun Kharge on Russia sanctions bill
en.summary: The U.S. House advanced legislation that would allow President Trump to impose 100% tariffs on India and other nations purchasing Russian oil and gas. Congress opposition leader Mallikarjun Kharge criticized the Indian government's response to U.S. pressure regarding the sanctions bill.

stories.title: U.S. lawmaker submits amendment naming India in Russia sanctions act

en.title: U.S. lawmaker submits amendment naming India in Russia sanctions act
en.summary: A U.S. lawmaker has proposed an amendment to the Lindsey Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which the Senate passed 86-11, to include India among countries subject to sanctions targeting Russia's energy sector and shadow fleet operations.

stories.title: NMDC recovers a 27.29-carat diamond from Panna mining project

en.title: NMDC recovers a 27.29-carat diamond from Panna mining project
en.summary: NMDC has recovered a 27.29-carat diamond from its Panna mine. The largest diamond previously found there was a 34.37-carat gem quality stone discovered in 2010 and sold for 3.2 crore rupees.

stories.title: Retail investors pull Rs 5,674 crore from stocks, invest Rs 12,618 crore into IPOs

en.title: Retail investors pull Rs 5,674 crore from stocks, invest Rs 12,618 crore into IPOs
en.summary: Indian retail investors withdrew funds from equities in July and August while allocating significantly more capital to IPOs. Analysts attribute this shift to profit-taking tactics, with strong IPO performance drawing investor interest.
